gawler-ranges-national-park-12.name: Australian Farmer Granite Sculpture
gawler-ranges-national-park-12.bio: A large granite farmer sculpted from two pieces of local pink granite beside the Wudinna Telecentre on the Eyre Highway.

gawler-ranges-national-park-13.name: Wudinna Granite Trail
gawler-ranges-national-park-13.bio: A 9 km walking and cycling trail from Wudinna to Little Mount Wudinna, best through the Polda Rock recreation reserve's mallee.

notes.pin: Route runs from Wudinna township along Standley Road to Little Mount Wudinna via Polda Rock Recreation Reserve; pin at route midpoint (OSM route if present)

cowell-silo-art.name: Cowell Silo Art
cowell-silo-art.bio: A three-silo mural at the corner of North Terrace and the Lincoln Highway, part of the Australian Silo Art Trail.

franklin-harbor-historical-museum.name: Franklin Harbor Historical Museum
franklin-harbor-historical-museum.bio: A volunteer-run museum of Cowell's local history, with displays and records, next to the council chambers on Main Street.

franklin-harbor-conservation-park.name: Franklin Harbor Conservation Park
franklin-harbor-conservation-park.bio: Mangroves and samphire flats that draw sea birds, 5 km from Cowell and reachable only by car.
franklin-harbor-conservation-park.coordinates_source: draft hint (Wikivoyage listing -33.7442,136.938, provisional, pending serial pin pass)

black-stump.name: Black Stump
black-stump.bio: A 2,060 kg stump between Cowell's two hotels, placed after a 1972 New Year's prank and rebuilt after fires.

notes.pin: 6 Main Street, Cowell, between the two hotels; town-centre point is acceptable if no OSM feature

black-stump.ticket_note: Roadside icon between two hotels with no steward site

wittelbee-conservation-park.name: Wittelbee Conservation Park
wittelbee-conservation-park.bio: A low rocky headland among mallee and high dunes with bushwalking tracks, shorebirds and samphire flats.

notes.pin: Wittelbee Point via Decres Bay Road; use the park access/camp area, not a centroid

arno-bay-estuary-boardwalk.name: Arno Bay Estuary Boardwalk
arno-bay-estuary-boardwalk.bio: A boardwalk through mangroves, mudflats and samphire beside the Arno Bay estuary, with a branch leading to the beach.

notes.pin: Car park on Creek Road, Arno Bay; pin at the middle of the boardwalk loop

arno-bay-estuary-boardwalk.ticket_note: Run by Cleve council, whose site is blocked to scripts

redbanks-beach.name: Redbanks Beach
redbanks-beach.bio: A beach north of Arno Bay named for its red cliffs, used for swimming, surfing and walks, with dolphins sometimes seen.

notes.pin: Red Banks Road beach access north of Arno Bay

cleve-hills-scenic-drive-and-lookout.name: Cleve Hills Scenic Drive and Lookout
cleve-hills-scenic-drive-and-lookout.bio: A scenic drive through farmland around Yeldulknie Conservation Park with a lookout over the Cleve district; dry weather only.

notes.pin: 426 Scenic Road, Cleve; pin at the lookout, not the town

cleve-hills-scenic-drive-and-lookout.ticket_note: Council page blocked to scripts; tourism landing not confirmed

observation-hill-lookout.name: Observation Hill Lookout
observation-hill-lookout.bio: Locally called Ticklebelly Hill, a patch of native bush with a walking trail, a lookout over Cleve and protected Silver Daisy.
